description: Paint finished, painterly images entirely with code, with no image model, reference images or downloaded assets. Builds a procedural underpainting (3D geometry, noise landscapes, mirrored water, lights), paints it with curved brush strokes along a style flow field, adds impasto, then inspects and iterates. Use for "paint X in the style of Y with code", "generative painting", "no-AI-image artwork", "made with Python" art, or procedural illustrations in post-impressionist, impressionist, ukiyo-e, or Northern Renaissance styles.
